note: Small demonstration dataset. Expected verdicts and rationales authored before model calls; not a legal accuracy benchmark.

rows.text: Provider may train general-purpose models on Customer Data without further permission. Customer grants a perpetual training license.
rows.rationale: Default and perpetual training permission contradicts specific written consent.

rows.text: The subscription automatically renews unless Customer gives notice at least 15 days before renewal.
rows.rationale: 15 days does not match the agreed 30 days.

rows.text: Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 60 days. There are no existing revisions at this location.
rows.rationale: 60 days contradicts the agreed 30-day period; classification does not authorize editing.

rows.text: Schedule C: De-identified Customer Data excerpts may be used for general-purpose model training without Customer consent, notwithstanding any conflicting restriction in Section 7.
rows.rationale: Express permission contradicts the required restriction and reverses its precedence.

rows.text: Provider must obtain Customer's specific prior written consent before using Customer Data to train shared or general-purpose models. No default or perpetual training license is granted.
rows.rationale: The complete permission matches the consent policy.

rows.text: The subscription automatically renews unless Customer gives notice at least 30 days before renewal.
rows.rationale: The notice period equals the agreed 30 days.

rows.text: Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days. Counsel's existing tracked revision changes 45 days to 30 days and remains pending.
rows.rationale: Counsel's existing revision implements the agreed payment term and must be preserved.

rows.text: Schedule C: Customer Data, including de-identified excerpts, must not be used to train shared or general-purpose models unless Customer gives specific prior written consent. This restriction prevails over conflicting permissions in Section 7 and any order form.
rows.rationale: Restriction, excerpt coverage and precedence are all explicit.

rows.text: Provider may use Customer Data for training as authorized under the separate Data Use Addendum. That addendum is unavailable and the scope of authorization has not been settled.
rows.rationale: Unavailable authorization cannot establish compliance or a definite violation.

rows.text: Non-renewal notice is due within the window specified in the applicable order form. Two conflicting unsigned drafts specify 15 and 30 days; no final order form is available.
rows.rationale: Conflicting drafts and missing final evidence leave the operative period unresolved.

rows.text: Invoices are due within the period separately agreed in writing. Counsel's unresolved alternatives specify 30 or 60 days and neither has been selected.
rows.rationale: The binding payment period is not settled.

rows.text: Schedule C incorporates a training safeguard from an unavailable annex. Its treatment of de-identified excerpts and priority over Section 7 is unknown.
rows.rationale: Unavailable terms and precedence require human review.

rows.text: The complete data-use section contains only confidentiality terms. There is no provision addressing use of Customer Data for model training.
rows.rationale: An absent required provision must be reviewed, not marked acceptable.

rows.text: The subscription renews annually. The complete agreement and order form contain no cancellation notice period.
Provider will invoice monthly. The complete agreement contains no payment due date or payment-period revision.
rows.rationale: Monthly invoicing does not establish the required 30-day payment term.

rows.text: Schedule C (complete): 1. Provider maintains security controls. 2. Provider notifies Customer of incidents. 3. Provider returns Customer Data on termination. No training safeguard is present.
rows.rationale: The absent training safeguard requires an expressly approved insertion.
